label: MS2000 / MS2000R ROMs
description: MS2KR runs the synthesizer's own firmware: add your own 1 MB flash dump and the DSP56362 boot ROM. They are not included with the plugin.
hint: Read flash.bin from your MS2000 or MS2000R with the MS2000 Flash Tool (never on an MS2000B / MS2000BR); the official firmware updater holds only the first 256 KB, which is not enough. Keep the boot ROM's name: boot-362.bin, or boot-362.ms2000.bin for the corrected copy (used first when both are there).

rules.label: Main flash (flash.bin, 1 MB)
rules.note: The right size for an MS2000 flash dump. MS2KR checks the firmware when it boots and shows the result on its LCD.

rules.label: DSP56362 boot ROM (boot-362.bin)
rules.note: The right size for the DSP56362 boot ROM.

rules.label: DSP56362 boot ROM, corrected copy (boot-362.ms2000.bin)
rules.note: The corrected boot ROM. MS2KR uses it in place of boot-362.bin when both are there.
